metadata.label: Note
value: The editio princeps of the King James' or Authorized version, also known as the Great HE edition, from the reading in Ruth III.15 "and he went into the citie."
The New Testament (A- 2A) has separate title page.

Printed in black letter in two columns per page within rules, with verse divisions, marginal notes, ornamental capitals, and head- and tail-pieces throughout; each chapter preceded by summary in roman type.
With: Speed, J.S. [The genealogies recorded in the Sacred Scriptures]. [London : J. Beale, 1611.]
